articles.title: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.

articles.title: $700M microgrid bill has state energy office, electrical manufacturer support
articles.summary: The bill would make microgrids and distributed energy resources eligible for state energy program grants and establish state-run grid resilience programs.

articles.title: America’s permitting crisis lives at City Hall
articles.summary: Every month a city spends re-reviewing a battery it has already certified safe is time wasted when that resource could be adding capacity to the grid or lowering a family's bill, writes Base Power COO Justin Lopas.

articles.title: Eversource Q2 income plunges on transmission ROE, offshore wind charges
articles.summary: Jefferies analysts cast doubt on Connecticut Light and Power’s $1 billion advanced metering infrastructure proposal, which has a negative benefit-to-cost ratio.

articles.title: Southern Co. contracted large load rises to 17 GW
articles.summary: Recently announced projects include a 3.2-GW OpenAI data center near Savannah, Georgia. The contract includes 1 GW of “flexible demand response” for peak shaving — the first such flexibility provision the company has codified with a data center customer.

articles.title: Dominion offshore wind project cost rises nearly $300M
articles.summary: The increase is due to revised network upgrade costs assigned by the PJM Interconnection, tariffs imposed by the Trump administration in April and updated turbine installation projections, executives said.

articles.title: AEP secures 13 GW of gas turbines as generation ‘central’ to growth plans
articles.summary: Turbines are “a scarce resource and will become increasingly more valuable,” AEP’s Bill Fehrman said. “We're going to continue to be aggressive in our positions on this.”

articles.title: DTE ties rate stability to data center projects as large-load pipeline remains steady
articles.summary: The company’s $30 billion electric utility capital investment plan was unchanged from the first quarter, officials said during the second-quarter earnings call.

articles.title: PJM files backstop auction plan at FERC to meet capacity shortfall
articles.summary: The proposal aims to fill a capacity shortfall driven by surging data center demand, which could grow by 70 GW by 2038, according to the PJM Interconnection. The success of the plan depends on states taking steps to protect their retail customers from cost shifts, it said.

articles.title: Leading the agentic grid transformation
articles.summary: The strategic priorities shaping the future of intelligent utility operations.

articles.title: Danube's record low leads to Hungary, Romania nuclear shutdowns
articles.summary: The operator of the Paks nuclear power plant in Hungary has announced it will have to be fully shut down within the next 72 hours because of record-low water levels in the River Danube. Romania's Cernavoda has also shut down one of its two units.

articles.title: Korean-US partnership for floating SMR platform
articles.summary: South Korean shipbuilding company Samsung Heavy Industries announced it has signed a memorandum of understanding with USA-based engineering firm Sargent & Lundy for the development of a standardised floating small modular reactor platform.

articles.title: Nuclearelectrica's proposal to review SMR options rejected by ministry
articles.summary: Romania's state-owned nuclear company had asked shareholders to approve "the initiation of steps to reassess the initial development strategy for small modular reactors by expanding the analysis to include other SMR technologies and broadening the list of potential sites (in the event of a decision to scale up)".

articles.title: Landmark module installation at Lufeng 2
articles.summary: The CA01 'super module' has been installed at unit 2 of the Lufeng nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province, China General Nuclear announced.

articles.title: First port signs up to US initiative on maritime SMRs
articles.summary: The Port of Long Beach in California has become the first port in the USA to sign a memorandum of cooperation with the Department of Transportation's Maritime Administration to advance work on development of small modular reactor technology to power commercial vessels, ports and other maritime assets.

articles.title: UK start-up Nuclear Turbines unveils novel reactor concept
articles.summary: The spin-off from BAE Systems has raised GBP15 million (USD19.9 million) funding and emerged from stealth with a nuclear reactor design combined with high-temperature turbine technology, which it says will lead to lower energy costs.

articles.title: Initiative launched to bolster Italian nuclear supply chain
articles.summary: Italian power technology firm Ansaldo Energia and certification and engineering company RINA have agreed to support the development of the country's nuclear supply chain and enable companies to seize opportunities in the rapidly growing global nuclear market by guiding them through a structured certification pathway.

articles.title: EDF teams up with Technip Energies for EPR2 delivery
articles.summary: French engineering and technology company Technip Energies announced it has signed a strategic framework agreement with EDF to support execution, construction management, and delivery of EDF's EPR2 reactor construction programme.

articles.title: Five potential states selected to host US nuclear innovation campuses
articles.summary: Following "record levels of interest", the US Department of Energy has announced the selection of Utah, Tennessee, Oklahoma, Louisiana, and Idaho as potential host states for Nuclear Lifecycle Innovation Campuses.

articles.title: McDermott to support potential Dutch Rolls-Royce SMR projects
articles.summary: Dutch nuclear development company ULC-Energy has signed a cooperation agreement with USA-based engineering and construction firm McDermott to support development of Rolls-Royce SMR projects in the Netherlands.

articles.title: Serbia signs fresh nuclear programme agreement with EDF
articles.summary: A partnership agreement has been signed by the Serbian government, French nuclear operator EDF and the French Development Agency relating to the development of Serbia's nuclear energy programme.

articles.title: Chinese helium turbine test facility completes hot testing
articles.summary: China's first megawatt-class helium turbine test facility, constructed by China National Nuclear Corporation subsidiary CNNC Huaxing, has successfully completed its hot power generation test.

articles.title: IAEA, Canadian university collaborate on nuclear education
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency and Canada's University of Saskatchewan have signed an agreement to strengthen cooperation in knowledge management and education, supporting nuclear energy research and workforce development.

articles.title: Site preparations under way for planned Kola units
articles.summary: The start of site preparation works for the Kola II nuclear power units follows the granting of a site licence by Russian regulator Rostekhnadzor earlier this month.

articles.title: ARC partners with INL for SMR deployment
articles.summary: ARC Clean Technology has signed an agreement aiming for the first-of-a-kind deployment of an ARC-100 small modular reactor at Idaho National Laboratory.

articles.title: Dominion keeps options open for North Anna new build
articles.summary: Dominion Energy is taking steps to preserve the Early Site Permit issued to its North Anna site in 2007. The Louisa County site is already home to two operating reactors.

articles.title: New Chinese reactors reach start-up milestones
articles.summary: Unit 3 of the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's Hainan province has begun supplying electricity to the grid, while unit 2 of the Taipingling plant in Guangdong has entered commercial operation. Both units feature Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors.

articles.title: China approves construction of eight more reactors
articles.summary: The construction of three pairs of Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors at the Jinqimen, Taipingling and Zhuanghe sites, as well as two Guohe One (CAP1400) reactors at the Laiyang site was approved during a State Council executive meeting chaired by Chinese Premier Li Qiang on 31 July.

articles.title: Molten salt reactor gets US safety design approval
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy's approval of the Nuclear Safety Design Agreement for Natura Resources' demonstration reactor is a key milestone towards first deployment of the advanced, liquid-fuelled nuclear reactor at Abilene Christian University in Texas.

articles.title: Oklo cleared to start up test reactor
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has granted authorisation to nuclear technology company Oklo to start up its Groves Isotope Test Reactor, located near Lockhart in Caldwell County, Texas.
